candidates.angle: They cling to worry until death
candidates.evidence: प्रलयान्ताम् (lasting until dissolution/death) / उपाश्रिताः (taking refuge in)

candidates.angle: They decide that enjoyment is all there is
candidates.evidence: कामोपभोगपरमाः (for whom desire-enjoyment is the highest) / एतावदिति निश्चिताः (deciding firmly that this is all)
चिन्ताम् अपरिमेयाम् च उपाश्रिताः (taking refuge in immeasurable worry)

angle_en: Pralayantam: worry as a permanent shelter
angle_hi: प्रलयान्ताम्: चिंता एक स्थायी आश्रय के रूप में

en.intro: Carrying on from the previous verse, Krishna now describes the restless inner state of those who live only for desire.
en.notice: Here the word pralayantam, lasting until death, shows that their worry is not a passing mood but a permanent shelter. They decide that desire-enjoyment is the highest goal, and that this is all there is.
en.next: Next Krishna shows how they bind themselves with hundreds of cords of hope to gather wealth unjustly.
en.meaning: They take refuge in endless worries that last until death, live only for acquiring and enjoying things, and decide that this is all there is.

hi.intro: पिछले श्लोक से आगे बढ़ते हुए, कृष्ण अब उन लोगों की बेचैन मनःस्थिति का वर्णन करते हैं जो केवल इच्छाओं में जीते हैं।
hi.meaning: वे मृत्यु तक रहनेवाली अपार चिन्ताओंका आश्रय लेनेवाले, पदार्थोंका संग्रह और उनका भोग करनेमें ही लगे रहनेवाले और जो कुछ है, वह इतना ही है ऐसा निश्चय करनेवाले होते हैं।
hi.next: आगे कृष्ण बताते हैं कि कैसे वे इच्छा और क्रोध के सैकड़ों बंधनों में बँधकर अन्यायपूर्वक धन इकट्ठा करने का प्रयास करते हैं।

en.intro: Carrying on from the previous verse, Krishna now describes the restless inner state of those who live only for desire.
en.body: They take refuge in endless worries that last until death, live only for acquiring and enjoying things, and decide that this is all there is. Here the word pralayantam, lasting until death, shows that their worry is not a passing mood but a permanent shelter. They decide that desire-enjoyment is the highest goal, and that this is all there is. Next Krishna shows how they bind themselves with hundreds of cords of hope to gather wealth unjustly.

issues: unsupported: "यहाँ प्रलयान्ताम् शब्द से पता चलता है कि उनकी चिंता कोई क्षणिक भाव नहीं, बल्कि एक स्थायी आश्रय है।" (The word 'pralayantam' means 'lasting until dissolution/death', not a 'permanent shelter' (स्थायी आश्रय). The notice misrepresents the specific meaning of the word by softening it into a 'permanent shelter'.)
